ns0:svg.ns0:title: Archetypes from incomplete categorical data with VBPCApy
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Synthetic categorical data generated from three archetypes, with 30 percent of entries unobserved. Panel a: the missing-aware one-hot encoding, with unobserved variables marked. Panel b: archetype memberships recovered from the VBPCA reconstruction, plotted in a triangle and coloured by each sample's dominant generating archetype. Panel c: recovered against generating memberships, close to the line of equality. Synthetic data; the component and archetype counts are supplied.
